card.kicker: FULL WALKTHROUGH · LIVE ON MONAD TESTNET
card.head: Thenar
card.sub: A market where people teach robots, own the data, and get paid on Monad.

lines: A full walkthrough of Thenar, live on Monad testnet. Every transaction is real.

scenes.title: Who it is for
lines: Robots learn from human demonstrations, and the people who record them are rarely paid and never own the result. Thenar is for them. The front page times Monad's blocks live.

scenes.title: The lab's side: a bounty from a Privy wallet
lines: First, the other side: a robotics lab. Its budget is a Privy server wallet, under a policy that allows exactly one action, funding a task on Thenar's contract.
It posts a bounty, Privy signs, and Monad makes it final. Asked to send money anywhere else, Privy refuses.
That's the lab side done: a funded task, with no payout key on anyone's laptop.

scenes.title: Onboarding, read from the chain
lines: An operator arrives. In production they sign in by email through Privy; here a test wallet is injected.

scenes.title: A passkey, verified on Monad
lines: Next, a passkey: Face ID, a fingerprint or a PIN. Its public key goes into PasskeyRegistry, and Monad's P-256 precompile checks every signature, so a paid run always comes from a person. The server then admits them to the corpus shares.

scenes.title: Mera: the key that drives the arm
lines: Through Mera, the passkey also derives the key a physical SO-101 obeys.

scenes.title: The station, in WebXR
notes: WEBXR · EMULATED HEADSET (IWER) · NOT A REAL QUEST
lines: Now the lab's task at the station. It can be driven by keyboard, by a leader arm over USB, or in a headset. Here it's WebXR, with Meta's emulator standing in for a Quest 3S.

scenes.title: Drive it with your hands
notes: WEBXR · EMULATED HEADSET (IWER) · LIVE MONAD TESTNET
lines: Squeeze to take the arm; it follows the controller millimetre for millimetre. The trigger closes the jaws. Lift, carry, and lower it into the ring. Every sample is kept for the verifier.

scenes.title: In tolerance
lines: In tolerance, scored from the same samples the verifier checks.

scenes.title: Gas, then submit
lines: The page prices gas on the limit, the way Monad charges it. Submit: the verifier re-scores and signs, and one transaction records the run and pays.

scenes.title: Executed, then final
lines: {TIMERS}
Details show the txpool, the receipt, and the block reaching the finalized tag, hash checked.

scenes.title: A share of the corpus
lines: The run also issues the operator shares of the corpus.

scenes.title: The dataset
lines: The corpus page: each episode drawn from the samples its hash commits to, a Merkle root over the paid set, and two ways to buy: a subscription for every task, or one task over x402.

scenes.title: An agent buys over x402
lines: An AI agent with a wallet and no account asks for the corpus, gets a 402, and pays one cent of USDC. Monad's facilitator settles it, and the agent checks the file against the sale log on chain.

scenes.title: Terms and sales, in public
lines: The terms and every sale are public.

scenes.title: Chainlink CRE audits the corpus
lines: Chainlink CRE audits Thenar's server: it rebuilds each task's Merkle root from the episodes, reads what's committed on Monad, and writes a verdict to CorpusAudit. This is the CRE simulator, with a real broadcast.

scenes.title: CRE's verdict: uncommitted
lines: The verdict, uncommitted, sits beside the data for any buyer to read.

scenes.title: Operators and agents
lines: The leaderboard ranks operators by what they've earned, read back from the trajectory ledger, and agents by what they've bought.

scenes.title: Monad, read live
lines: Finally, the network page reads Monad and Ethereum side by side: block time, time to final, gas price, and how each one charges gas. It checks a P-256 signature through the precompile live.
That's Thenar: identity, provenance, payment and ownership, each enforced on Monad.

scenes.title: On a real Quest 3S
lines: And this is a real Quest 3S: the operator's own view, hands on the controllers, driving the same arm.

card.head: Thenar
card.sub: Drive a robot. Own the data. Get paid on Monad.
